items.title: Introducing AI Futures
items.lead_paragraph: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.

items.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
items.lead_paragraph: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

items.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
items.lead_paragraph: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe
items.lead_paragraph: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

items.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

items.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
items.lead_paragraph: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.

items.title: How NVIDIA scales expertise with ChatGPT Work
items.lead_paragraph: NVIDIA teams use ChatGPT Work to reduce manual tasks, connect fast-moving signals, and scale successful workflows globally.

items.title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
items.lead_paragraph: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.

items.title: The Defender’s Window
items.lead_paragraph: AI is reshaping cybersecurity for attackers and defenders alike. Learn how OpenAI is strengthening its defenses and what security teams can do now.

items.title: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project, expanding community investment and supporting thousands of Southern Ohio jobs

items.title: New policy ideas for the Intelligence Age
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI funds 14 independent projects exploring new AI policy ideas to expand economic opportunity and strengthen societal resilience in the Intelligence Age.

items.title: From Atari to EVE Online: Building on 15 Years of AI Research in Games
items.lead_paragraph: Google DeepMind partners with game studios to prototype breakthrough AI gameplay.
